name: 23035-longprompt-52b-1gpu
model: ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Mini-1.7-FP8 -- gated on Hugging Face, access must be granted before the first run
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; 55.1 GB of weights fit one 80 GB card.
architecture: JambaForCausalLM hybrid decoder: 32 layers, 28 state-space (Mamba-1) mixers and 4 attention, MoE feed-forward (16 experts, 2 active), FP8 weights over 12 shards, 55.1 GB, ~52B parameters with ~12B active. No substitute checkpoint reproduces it.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1 -- one request in flight -- warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 60 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, so ~48 are scored. Seed 42. Each scored request contributes 127 inter-token intervals, so ITL_p95 rests on ~6100 observations; E2E_p95 rests on the 48.
workload: synthetic_text, 31500 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens per request, no stdev declared so every request is exactly that; temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, ignore_eos. The prompt is rendered through the chat template and tokenized with add_special_tokens, so the engine counts ~31500-31530 rather than 31500 exactly.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a 52-billion-parameter hybrid model, serving one 31,000-token request at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine is the commit 2461d9e562e5 (`git describe` v0.10.1rc1-102-g2461d9e562e5), not a
# release; configs/env.yaml names the interpreter it lives in.
#
# Two variables have no engine argument at this pin and must be set at launch:
#     VLLM_USE_V1=1  VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASHINFER

# GATED on Hugging Face. Do not substitute another checkpoint: this hybrid architecture is the
# setup.
model: ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-Mini-1.7-FP8

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The workload's worst case is 31500 prompt + 128 output = 31628 tokens.
max-model-len: 32768

# The pinned engine's own defaults for a >= 70 GiB non-A100 device, written out rather than left
# implicit: some launch paths resolve the library defaults (2048 and 128) instead, which is a
# different setup. One-request-in-flight is expressed as the LOAD, in scenario.json's `streams`.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024

# The engine default, written out so a future default cannot drift it.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# Off: the synthetic prompts are drawn fresh per request, so there is nothing to hit.
enable-prefix-caching: false
